result.instructions: Tools for Facture App, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the clients in my Facture account."; "Create a product called consulting, 1500 pesos plus IVA."; "Show the invoices issued this period and which ones are cancelled.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Facture App data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run facture_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run facture_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run facture_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. facture_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: facture_list_issuers
tools.title: List issuers
tools.description: List the issuers (emisores: the taxpayers that can stamp invoices) on this Facture account, with their RFC. Use an RFC to filter branches. Facture API: GET /emisor/find.

tools.name: facture_list_branches
tools.title: List branches
tools.description: List the branches (sucursales) that can stamp invoices. Each branch id is the branch_id that facture_stamp_invoice needs. Pass issuer_rfc to show only one issuer's branches. Facture API: GET /sucursal/find.

issuer_rfc.description: Show only branches of this issuer RFC.

tools.name: facture_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (receptores) in the account catalog: name, RFC, tax regime and address. Facture API: GET /cliente/find.

tools.name: facture_list_products
tools.title: List products and services
tools.description: List the products and services (conceptos) in the account catalog, with their unit prices and SAT keys. Facture API: GET /concepto/find.

tools.name: facture_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices (comprobantes) issued from this account: folio, series, total, receiver and cancelled flag. Facture API: GET /facturacion/find.

tools.name: facture_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one stamped invoice by its fiscal UUID: date, type, folio, currency, cancelled flag and totals. Facture API: GET /facturacion?id=<uuid>.

tools.name: facture_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a client (receptor) in the account catalog. The SAT requires the RFC, tax regime, CFDI use and a fiscal address. Creates a record only; it stamps nothing. Facture API: POST /cliente.

rfc.description: RFC. Use XAXX010101000 for the general public.

tax_regime.description: SAT tax regime code, for example 601 (regimen).

cfdi_use.description: CFDI use code, for example G01 (usoCFDI).

state.description: State name, for example Michoacán de Ocampo (estado).

tools.name: facture_create_product
tools.title: Create a product or service
tools.description: Create a product or service (concepto) in the account catalog with a unit price in MXN and one IVA rate. Creates a record only; it stamps nothing. Facture API: POST /concepto.

product_key.description: SAT product or service key, for example 43201902 (claveProdServ).

unit_key.description: SAT unit key, for example H87 for piece (claveUnidad).

unit_price.description: Unit price in MXN, before tax (precio).

vat_rate.description: IVA rate as a fraction: 0.16 = 16%. Default 0.16.

tools.name: facture_stamp_invoice
tools.title: Stamp an invoice
tools.description: Stamp (timbrar) one CFDI invoice from a Facture JSON document, through the given branch. This issues a real tax invoice with the SAT and uses Facture credits: call it only after the user confirms every field. The stamped XML is left out of the reply; get it from Facture. Facture API: POST /timbrado/json.

invoice_json.description: The CFDI as a Facture JSON document (text). It is sent base64 encoded.

branch_id.description: Branch id that signs the invoice (from facture_list_branches).

tools.name: facture_cancel_invoice
tools.title: Cancel an invoice
tools.description: Cancel (cancelar) one stamped invoice with the SAT. Reason 01 means an error with a replacement invoice: it needs replacement_uuid. Reasons 02 to 04 need no replacement. Cancelling can need the receiver's approval; the reply says so. Facture API: POST /cancelacion.

uuid.description: The fiscal UUID of the invoice to cancel.

reason.description: 01 error with a replacement, 02 error without a replacement, 03 operation not carried out, 04 global invoice.

replacement_uuid.description: Fiscal UUID of the replacement invoice. Required for reason 01.
